# Autumn Colors

[**Sounkyo (Hokkaido)** \\
Part of the Daisetsuzan National Park in Hokkaido prefecture, the Sounkyo area\\
comprises a range of gorges surrounded by 100-meter-high cliffs. The area is\\
particularly beautiful in the fall season, with hiking tours available most of the year.](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/1875/) [www.japan.travel/en/spot/1875/](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/1875/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/06/b7/06b7d3a1-bea8-4ce7-b2c7-c3e5357a4fbe/autumn-banner01_xkg9fs)

[**Tsutanuma (Aomori)** \\
Lake Tsutanuma in the Aomori Prefecture is home to a vibrant "vermillion vista", which\\
makes it look like the sides of the mountain surrounding it are on fire. The ancient\\
beech forests around it appear drenched in yellow paint until the morning sun hits them\\
& creates a rich reddish hue. This special sight can only be seen in the early mornings\\
in the second half of October.](https://www.japan.travel/en/japan-magazine/1809_towada/) [www.japan.travel/en/japan-magazine/1809\_towada/](https://www.japan.travel/en/japan-magazine/1809_towada/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/26/33/2633ea28-d020-4ccc-9c05-abe6054068c9/autumn-banner02_rrgld0)

[**Kegon Falls (Tochigi)** \\
Surrounded by the breathtaking landscape of Nikko National Park in\\
the Tochigi Prefecture, Kegon Falls is known as one of Japan’s top three greatest waterfalls and has a breathtaking 97-meter drop. Though stunning in every season, its colourful autumnal change as the surrounding foliage turns golden brown and red attracts visitors from across the world.](https://www.japan.travel/en/japans-local-treasures/kegon-falls/) [www.japan.travel/en/japans-local-treasures/kegon-falls/](https://www.japan.travel/en/japans-local-treasures/kegon-falls/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/85/77/85779ba0-fe46-45e2-8b77-91a9c7d5da47/autumn-banner03_rzsixs)

[**Meijijingu Gaien (Tokyo)** \\
Situated between Aoyama’s business district and Meiji Jingu Gaien Park is Icho Namiki Avenue, one of Tokyo’s most scenic natural walkways. Though beautiful throughout the year, the ginkgo trees lining Icho Namiki Avenue are a blazing bright yellow in the autumn season.](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/378/) [www.japan.travel/en/spot/378/](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/378/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/84/f9/84f9f7d7-b601-41c7-b9f9-de276d73b256/autumn-banner04_sxiqub)

[**Happoike Pond (Nagano)** \\
Happoike Pond in Nagano Prefecture is a beautiful fiery mountain range in autumn.\\
On a clear day, the peaks of the Northern Alps in Japan are reflected in the crystal\\
waters of Happoike Pond.](https://www.japan.travel/national-parks/parks/chubusangaku/explore/) [www.japan.travel/national-parks/parks/chubusangaku/explore/](https://www.japan.travel/national-parks/parks/chubusangaku/explore/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/8a/bf/8abfbacb-2074-4449-8ef2-e4b8ff03aaa4/autumn-banner05_rors0s)

[**Kurobe Gorge (Toyama)** \\
Charting a course through around 20 kilometers of lushly wooded mountain terrain, the Kurobe Gorge Railway in Toyama Prefecture combines spectacular vistas and a sense of dynamism unique to rail travel. During the peak period in October, bold swathes of yellow and red turn the hillsides into a giant tapestry of autumn colors.](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/248/) [www.japan.travel/en/spot/248/](https://www.japan.travel/en/spot/248/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/2b/ef/2befc542-2519-474e-818a-e877a8d4d233/autumn-banner06_eatw14)

[**Iya Valley (Tokushima)** \\
The Iya Valley is in Tokushima prefecture, on the island of Shikoku. This stunning region is known for its natural beauty, particularly in the fall when its changing leaves present a picturesque view.](https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/shikoku/tokushima/iya-valley-area/) [www.japan.travel/en/destinations/shikoku/tokushima/iya-valley-area/](https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/shikoku/tokushima/iya-valley-area/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/d0/3a/d03a630e-196c-4538-b8ce-9daa7e1dfb77/autumn-banner08_gr7xr7)

[**Yufuin (Oita)** \\
Yufuin in Oita Prefecture offers bathing and sightseeing spots as well as easy access to lakes and mountains. With a colourful history and incredibly rare natural sites, this is a very beautiful place, especially in the autumn. During autumn and winter mornings, consider a trip to Lake Kinrinko to take in the serene, misty landscape.](https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/kyushu/oita/beppu-and-yufuin-around/) [www.japan.travel/en/destinations/kyushu/oita/beppu-and-yufuin-around/](https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/kyushu/oita/beppu-and-yufuin-around/)

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/jnto/image/upload/w_650,h_432,f_auto,fl_lossy,q_auto,c_fill/v1/media/filer_public/d0/a6/d0a6442c-5877-4ce2-b9a3-1bdacb9d6356/autumn-banner09_lppzvx)
